projects.license: This upstream repository ships without a license file. Its author (Bread-Ch4n) publishes it publicly for the Ficsit Remote Monitoring Web UI. Reuse of its self-contained visual/UI components in this console was explicitly authorized by the owner of this repository (Dave) on 2026-10-31. Only the framework-independent visual effect techniques were ported; no FRM game mod, FRM data endpoint, build step or React/Next runtime was adopted. If the upstream later publishes a license, it supersedes this note.
projects.use: Adapted techniques → satisfactory_webui/web/fx.css and fx.js: (1) magic-card.tsx mouse-following radial-gradient glow (handleMouseMove / mouseout), re-implemented in vanilla JS; (2) shine-border.tsx animated gradient border; (3) animated-grid-pattern.tsx / dot-pattern.tsx grid and dot backgrounds; (4) ripple.tsx concentric pulsing rings; (5) globals.css .card:hover orange outer-glow + subtle scale, applied site-wide. All effects honour prefers-reduced-motion. Data pages (power, production, map, drone, resource sink) were NOT ported: they require the FRM game mod, which is not installed and is not required of any player.
